passages.text: This is what the LORD says to Cyrus His anointed, whose right hand I have grasped to subdue nations before him, to disarm kings, to open the doors before him, so that the gates will not be shut: “I will go before you and level the mountains; I will break down the gates of bronze and cut through the bars of iron.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the only God.
The LORD speaks to Cyrus.
Cyrus is the LORD’s anointed.
The LORD has taken hold of Cyrus’s right hand.
The LORD gives Cyrus power over nations.
The LORD makes kings weak before Cyrus.
The LORD opens doors in front of Cyrus.
No gates will stay closed against Cyrus.
The LORD will go ahead of Cyrus.
The LORD will make rough places smooth for Cyrus.
The LORD will break down bronze gates.
The LORD will cut through iron bars.
passages.original: כֹּה־ אָמַ֣ר יְהוָה֮ לִמְשִׁיחוֹ֮ לְכ֣וֹרֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר־ הֶחֱזַ֣קְתִּי בִֽימִינ֗וֹ לְרַד־ לְפָנָיו֙ גּוֹיִ֔ם וּמָתְנֵ֥י מְלָכִ֖ים אֲפַתֵּ֑חַ לִפְתֹּ֤חַ לְפָנָיו֙ דְּלָתַ֔יִם וּשְׁעָרִ֖ים לֹ֥א יִסָּגֵֽרוּ׃ אֲנִי֙ לְפָנֶ֣יךָ אֵלֵ֔ךְ וַהֲדוּרִ֖ים אוֹשִׁר דַּלְת֤וֹת נְחוּשָׁה֙ אֲשַׁבֵּ֔ר וּבְרִיחֵ֥י בַרְזֶ֖ל אֲגַדֵּֽעַ׃

passages.text: I will give you the treasures of darkness and the riches hidden in secret places, so that you may know that I am the LORD, the God of Israel, who calls you by name.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the God of Israel.
The LORD calls you by name.
The LORD will give you treasures that are hidden in darkness.
The LORD will give you riches that are kept in secret places.
The LORD does this so you will know Him.
The LORD wants you to know that He is the LORD.
The LORD is the God of Israel.
The LORD calls you by your name.
passages.original: וְנָתַתִּ֤י לְךָ֙ אוֹצְר֣וֹת חֹ֔שֶׁךְ וּמַטְמֻנֵ֖י מִסְתָּרִ֑ים לְמַ֣עַן תֵּדַ֗ע כִּֽי־ אֲנִ֧י יְהוָ֛ה הַקּוֹרֵ֥א בְשִׁמְךָ֖ אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

passages.text: For the sake of Jacob My servant and Israel My chosen one, I call you by name; I have given you a title of honor, though you have not known Me.
passages.sermon:
The LORD speaks to Cyrus.
The LORD is the God of Israel.
The LORD has chosen Israel.
The LORD calls Jacob His servant.
The LORD calls Israel His chosen one.
The LORD acts for the sake of Jacob and Israel.
The LORD calls Cyrus by name.
The LORD gives Cyrus a title of honor.
Cyrus does not know the LORD.
passages.original: לְמַ֙עַן֙ עַבְדִּ֣י יַעֲקֹ֔ב וְיִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בְּחִירִ֑י וָאֶקְרָ֤א לְךָ֙ בִּשְׁמֶ֔ךָ אֲכַנְּךָ֖ וְלֹ֥א יְדַעְתָּֽנִי׃

passages.text: I am the LORD, and there is no other; there is no God but Me. I will equip you for battle, though you have not known Me, so that all may know, from where the sun rises to where it sets, that there is none but Me; I am the LORD, and there is no other.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God.
There is no other God.
God alone is the LORD.
God equips you for battle.
You did not know God.
God does this so everyone will know Him.
People everywhere will know God.
People from the east, where the sun rises, will know God.
People from the west, where the sun sets, will know God.
There is no one besides God.
God alone is the LORD.
There is no other.
passages.original: אֲנִ֤י יְהוָה֙ וְאֵ֣ין ע֔וֹד זוּלָתִ֖י אֵ֣ין אֱלֹהִ֑ים אֲאַזֶּרְךָ֖ וְלֹ֥א יְדַעְתָּֽנִי׃ לְמַ֣עַן יֵדְע֗וּ מִמִּזְרַח־ שֶׁ֙מֶשׁ֙ וּמִמַּ֣עֲרָבָ֔הּ כִּי־ אֶ֖פֶס בִּלְעָדָ֑י אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה וְאֵ֥ין עֽוֹד׃

passages.text: I form the light and create the darkness; I bring prosperity and create calamity. I, the LORD, do all these things.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the only God.
The LORD forms the light.
The LORD creates the darkness.
The LORD brings peace.
The LORD creates calamity.
The LORD does all these things.
passages.original: יוֹצֵ֥ר אוֹר֙ וּבוֹרֵ֣א חֹ֔שֶׁךְ עֹשֶׂ֥ה שָׁל֖וֹם וּב֣וֹרֵא רָ֑ע אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה עֹשֶׂ֥ה כָל־ אֵֽלֶּה׃ס

passages.text: Drip down, O heavens, from above, and let the skies pour down righteousness. Let the earth open up that salvation may sprout and righteousness spring up with it; I, the LORD, have created it.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the only God.
The LORD created all things.
The LORD speaks.
He says, “Heavens, send down rain from above.
Skies, pour down righteousness.
Earth, open up.
Let salvation grow from the earth.
Let righteousness grow together with salvation.
I am the LORD.
I created all these things.”
passages.original: הַרְעִ֤יפוּ שָׁמַ֙יִם֙ מִמַּ֔עַל וּשְׁחָקִ֖ים יִזְּלוּ־ צֶ֑דֶק תִּפְתַּח־ אֶ֣רֶץ וְיִפְרוּ־ יֶ֗שַׁע וּצְדָקָ֤ה תַצְמִ֙יחַ֙ יַ֔חַד אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה בְּרָאתִֽיו׃ס

passages.text: Woe to him who quarrels with his Maker— one clay pot among many. Does the clay ask the potter, ‘What are you making?’ Does your work say, ‘He has no hands’?
passages.sermon:
God is the Maker.
God forms people as a potter shapes clay.
A person is like a clay pot among many pots.
Woe to anyone who argues with God, his Maker.
The clay does not ask the potter, "What are you making?"
A person's work does not say to the Maker, "You have no hands."
passages.original: ה֗וֹי רָ֚ב אֶת־ יֹ֣צְר֔וֹ חֶ֖רֶשׂ אֶת־ חַרְשֵׂ֣י אֲדָמָ֑ה הֲיֹאמַ֨ר חֹ֤מֶר לְיֹֽצְרוֹ֙ מַֽה־ תַּעֲשֶׂ֔ה וּפָעָלְךָ֖ אֵין־ יָדַ֥יִם לֽוֹ׃ס

passages.text: Woe to him who says to his father, ‘What have you begotten?’ or to his mother, ‘What have you brought forth?’ ”
passages.sermon:
God speaks to the people of Israel.
God is their Creator and the Holy One.
God warns those who question their parents.
A person may say to his father, “What have you begotten?”
A person may say to his mother, “What have you brought forth?”
God says woe to anyone who speaks this way.
God condemns those who challenge their parents about their birth.
passages.original: ה֛וֹי אֹמֵ֥ר לְאָ֖ב מַה־ תּוֹלִ֑יד וּלְאִשָּׁ֖ה מַה־ תְּחִילִֽין׃ס

passages.text: Thus says the LORD, the Holy One of Israel, and its Maker: “How dare you question Me about My sons, or instruct Me in the work of My hands?
passages.sermon:
The LORD speaks.
The LORD is the Holy One of Israel.
The LORD made Israel.
The LORD says this:
Do not question Me about My children.
Do not command Me about the work I do with My hands.
passages.original: כֹּֽה־ אָמַ֧ר יְהוָ֛ה קְד֥וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל וְיֹצְר֑וֹ הָאֹתִיּ֣וֹת שְׁאָל֔וּנִי עַל־ בָּנַ֛י וְעַל־ פֹּ֥עַל יָדַ֖י תְּצַוֻּֽנִי׃

passages.text: It is I who made the earth and created man upon it. It was My hands that stretched out the heavens, and I ordained all their host.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the Holy One of Israel.
The LORD is the Maker of all things.
The LORD says, "I made the earth."
I created man and placed him on the earth.
My hands stretched out the heavens.
I commanded all the stars and their hosts."
passages.original: אָֽנֹכִי֙ עָשִׂ֣יתִי אֶ֔רֶץ וְאָדָ֖ם עָלֶ֣יהָ בָרָ֑אתִי אֲנִ֗י יָדַי֙ נָט֣וּ שָׁמַ֔יִם וְכָל־ צְבָאָ֖ם צִוֵּֽיתִי׃

passages.text: I will raise up Cyrus in righteousness, and I will make all his ways straight. He will rebuild My city and set My exiles free, but not for payment or reward, says the LORD of Hosts.”
passages.sermon:
The LORD of Hosts speaks.
The LORD is the God of Israel.
The LORD is holy and powerful.
The LORD says, "I will raise up Cyrus.
I will make Cyrus righteous.
I will guide all his ways.
Cyrus will rebuild My city.
Cyrus will set My exiles free.
He will not do this for payment.
He will not do this for a reward."
passages.original: אָנֹכִי֙ הַעִירֹתִ֣הֽוּ בְצֶ֔דֶק וְכָל־ דְּרָכָ֖יו אֲיַשֵּׁ֑ר הֽוּא־ יִבְנֶ֤ה עִירִי֙ וְגָלוּתִ֣י יְשַׁלֵּ֔חַ לֹ֤א בִמְחִיר֙ וְלֹ֣א בְשֹׁ֔חַד אָמַ֖ר יְהוָ֥ה צְבָאֽוֹת׃פ

passages.text: This is what the LORD says: “The products of Egypt and the merchandise of Cush, along with the Sabeans, men of stature, will come over to you and will be yours; they will trudge behind you; they will come over in chains and bow down to you. They will confess to you: ‘God is indeed with you, and there is no other; there is no other God.’ ”
passages.sermon:
The LORD speaks.
The LORD is the God of Israel.
The LORD is the only true God.
The LORD says these words.
The wealth of Egypt will come to you.
The goods of Cush will come to you.
The Sabeans are tall men.
The Sabeans will come to you.
All these people will belong to you.
They will walk behind you.
They will come in chains.
They will bow down to you.
They will pray to you.
They will say, “God is truly with you.”
They will say, “There is no other God.”
They will say, “There is no God except Him.”
passages.original: כֹּ֣ה׀ אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֗ה יְגִ֨יעַ מִצְרַ֥יִם וּֽסְחַר־ כּוּשׁ֮ וּסְבָאִים֮ אַנְשֵׁ֣י מִדָּה֒ עָלַ֤יִךְ יַעֲבֹ֙רוּ֙ וְלָ֣ךְ יִֽהְי֔וּ אַחֲרַ֣יִךְ יֵלֵ֔כוּ בַּזִּקִּ֖ים יַעֲבֹ֑רוּ וְאֵלַ֤יִךְ יִֽשְׁתַּחֲוּוּ֙ אֵלַ֣יִךְ יִתְפַּלָּ֔לוּ אַ֣ךְ בָּ֥ךְ אֵ֛ל וְאֵ֥ין ע֖וֹד אֶ֥פֶס אֱלֹהִֽים׃

passages.text: Truly You are a God who hides Himself, O God of Israel, the Savior.
passages.sermon:
God is the God of Israel.
God saves Israel.
God hides Himself.
God is truly hidden.
passages.original: אָכֵ֕ן אַתָּ֖ה אֵ֣ל מִסְתַּתֵּ֑ר אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מוֹשִֽׁיעַ׃

passages.text: They will all be put to shame and humiliated; the makers of idols will depart together in disgrace.
passages.sermon:
The makers of idols create false gods.
All of them will feel shame.
All of them will be humiliated.
They will leave together in disgrace.
passages.original: בּ֥וֹשׁוּ וְגַֽם־ נִכְלְמ֖וּ כֻּלָּ֑ם יַחְדָּו֙ הָלְכ֣וּ בַכְּלִמָּ֔ה חָרָשֵׁ֖י צִירִֽים׃

passages.text: But Israel will be saved by the LORD with an everlasting salvation; you will not be put to shame or humiliated, to ages everlasting.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the God of Israel.
The LORD saves Israel.
The LORD gives Israel everlasting salvation.
Israel will not be put to shame.
Israel will not be humiliated.
This will last forever.
passages.original: יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ נוֹשַׁ֣ע בַּיהוָ֔ה תְּשׁוּעַ֖ת עוֹלָמִ֑ים לֹא־ תֵבֹ֥שׁוּ וְלֹא־ תִכָּלְמ֖וּ עַד־ ע֥וֹלְמֵי עַֽד׃פ

passages.text: For thus says the LORD, who created the heavens—He is God; He formed the earth and fashioned it; He established it; He did not create it to be empty, but formed it to be inhabited: “I am the LORD, and there is no other.
passages.sermon:
The LORD speaks.
The LORD created the heavens.
The LORD is God.
The LORD formed the earth.
The LORD made the earth.
The LORD established the earth.
The LORD did not create the earth to be empty.
The LORD formed the earth to be inhabited.
The LORD says, "I am the LORD."
There is no other God.
passages.original: כִּ֣י כֹ֣ה אָֽמַר־ יְ֠הוָה בּוֹרֵ֨א הַשָּׁמַ֜יִם ה֣וּא הָאֱלֹהִ֗ים יֹצֵ֨ר הָאָ֤רֶץ וְעֹשָׂהּ֙ ה֣וּא כֽוֹנְנָ֔הּ לֹא־ תֹ֥הוּ בְרָאָ֖הּ לָשֶׁ֣בֶת יְצָרָ֑הּ אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה וְאֵ֥ין עֽוֹד׃

passages.text: I have not spoken in secret, from a place in a land of darkness. I did not say to the descendants of Jacob, ‘Seek Me in a wasteland.’ I, the LORD, speak the truth; I say what is right.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is speaking.
The LORD is the God of Israel.
The LORD does not speak in secret.
The LORD does not speak from a place of darkness.
The LORD did not tell the descendants of Jacob to seek Him in a wasteland.
The LORD speaks the truth.
The LORD says what is right.
passages.original: לֹ֧א בַסֵּ֣תֶר דִּבַּ֗רְתִּי בִּמְקוֹם֙ אֶ֣רֶץ חֹ֔שֶׁךְ לֹ֥א אָמַ֛רְתִּי לְזֶ֥רַע יַעֲקֹ֖ב תֹּ֣הוּ בַקְּשׁ֑וּנִי אֲנִ֤י יְהוָה֙ דֹּבֵ֣ר צֶ֔דֶק מַגִּ֖יד מֵישָׁרִֽים׃

passages.text: Come, gather together, and draw near, you fugitives from the nations. Ignorant are those who carry idols of wood and pray to a god that cannot save.
passages.sermon:
The Lord speaks to the fugitives from the nations.
He calls them to come.
He tells them to gather together.
He tells them to draw near.
Some people carry idols made of wood.
These people pray to a god that cannot save.
These people do not understand.
Only the Lord is God.
Only the Lord can save.
passages.original: הִקָּבְצ֥וּ וָבֹ֛אוּ הִֽתְנַגְּשׁ֥וּ יַחְדָּ֖ו פְּלִיטֵ֣י הַגּוֹיִ֑ם לֹ֣א יָדְע֗וּ הַנֹּֽשְׂאִים֙ אֶת־ עֵ֣ץ פִּסְלָ֔ם וּמִתְפַּלְלִ֔ים אֶל־ אֵ֖ל לֹ֥א יוֹשִֽׁיעַ׃

passages.text: Speak up and present your case— yes, let them take counsel together. Who foretold this long ago? Who announced it from ancient times? Was it not I, the LORD? There is no other God but Me, a righteous God and Savior; there is none but Me.
passages.sermon:
God is speaking.
God is the LORD.
God is righteous.
God is the only Savior.
God commands, "Speak up and present your case."
God says, "Let them take counsel together."
God asks, "Who foretold this long ago?"
God asks, "Who announced it from ancient times?"
God answers, "Was it not I, the LORD?"
God declares, "There is no other God but Me."
God says, "There is none but Me."
God alone is righteous.
God alone saves.
passages.original: הַגִּ֣ידוּ וְהַגִּ֔ישׁוּ אַ֥ף יִֽוָּעֲצ֖וּ יַחְדָּ֑ו מִ֣י הִשְׁמִיעַ֩ זֹ֨את מִקֶּ֜דֶם מֵאָ֣ז הִגִּידָ֗הּ הֲל֨וֹא אֲנִ֤י יְהוָה֙ וְאֵֽין־ ע֤וֹד אֱלֹהִים֙ מִבַּלְעָדַ֔י אֵֽל־ צַדִּ֣יק וּמוֹשִׁ֔יעַ אַ֖יִן זוּלָתִֽי׃

passages.text: Turn to Me and be saved, all the ends of the earth; for I am God, and there is no other.
passages.sermon:
God speaks.
God is the only God.
There is no other God besides Him.
God calls to all people everywhere.
He says, “Turn to Me.”
He says, “Be saved.”
He calls to everyone on earth.
He alone is God.
No one else is God.
passages.original: פְּנוּ־ אֵלַ֥י וְהִוָּשְׁע֖וּ כָּל־ אַפְסֵי־ אָ֑רֶץ כִּ֥י אֲנִי־ אֵ֖ל וְאֵ֥ין עֽוֹד׃

passages.text: By Myself I have sworn; truth has gone out from My mouth, a word that will not be revoked: Every knee will bow before Me, every tongue will swear allegiance.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the only God.
The LORD is righteous and saves.
The LORD speaks truth.
The LORD swears by Himself.
The LORD says, “My word is true.
My word will not change.
Every knee will bow to Me.
Every tongue will swear loyalty to Me.”
passages.original: בִּ֣י נִשְׁבַּ֔עְתִּי יָצָ֨א מִפִּ֧י צְדָקָ֛ה דָּבָ֖ר וְלֹ֣א יָשׁ֑וּב כִּי־ לִי֙ תִּכְרַ֣ע כָּל־ בֶּ֔רֶךְ תִּשָּׁבַ֖ע כָּל־ לָשֽׁוֹן׃

passages.text: Surely they will say of Me, ‘In the LORD alone are righteousness and strength.’ ” All who rage against Him will come to Him and be put to shame.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God.
The LORD alone gives righteousness.
The LORD alone gives strength.
People will say this about the LORD.
Everyone who opposes the LORD will come to Him.
Everyone who opposes the LORD will feel shame.
passages.original: אַ֧ךְ בַּיהוָ֛ה לִ֥י אָמַ֖ר צְדָק֣וֹת וָעֹ֑ז עָדָיו֙ יָב֣וֹא וְיֵבֹ֔שׁוּ כֹּ֖ל הַנֶּחֱרִ֥ים בּֽוֹ׃

passages.text: In the LORD all descendants of Israel will be justified and will exult.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is righteous and strong.
All descendants of Israel belong to Him.
The LORD justifies all descendants of Israel.
All descendants of Israel will rejoice in the LORD.
passages.original: בַּיהוָ֛ה יִצְדְּק֥וּ וְיִֽתְהַלְל֖וּ כָּל־ זֶ֥רַע יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
